description: Authentication endpoint for the Flask application. Accepts POST requests with username and password. Returns 302 redirect to /welcome on successful authentication, sets session cookie.
notes: Endpoint requires POST method (GET returns 405). Accepts username and password parameters. Valid credentials (test1:test1) return 302 redirect to /welcome and set session cookie with value like: b734b58b2c18f64f8436e13335b4a164e96444ab6cbc223f236ffffffd000a22. Invalid credentials return 403 with message 'Invalid username or password'. Credentials are exposed in HTML comment of homepage.
